# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser-native game titled **Streamer Tycoon: Bestie Office Live**. Preserve the source loop exactly: start, choose one of three content arcs, tap to fill progress, publish automatically at full progress, gain randomized viewer score, then repeat with no fail timer.

Theme the play as a cozy satirical office creator economy pod inspired by workplace mockumentary energy: reply-all drama, boss walk-bys, breakroom unboxings, spreadsheet glow-ups, rainbowcore/y2k desk decor, labubu desk buddy, and bestie meme tone. Use readable mobile HUD, large tap targets, anti-anxiety copy, procedural canvas avatar/desk/background, and catalog-approved fonts/GIF feedback.

A satirical game inspired by The Office built around streamer tycoon play, with creative, cozy, customizable energy, anti anxiety session design, search-friendly hooks like streamer tycoon, tycoon, idle, aesthetics like rainbowcore, y2k, decora kei, and meme-tone cues such as labubu, bestie. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint — Streamer Tycoon: Bestie Office Live

## Source truth
The observed source is a portrait-first idle/clicker loop: start from a menu, choose one of three randomized content arcs, tap a full-screen bottom playfield target until edit progress reaches 100, publish automatically, gain a randomized viewer score with a small existing-audience scaling term, then repeat. There is no loss state, timer, physics collision, or win condition.

## Protected mechanics
- Start button enters the active loop.
- Three choice buttons select the next content arc.
- Active editing accepts one-thumb tap/click input only while the tap zone is visible.
- Each tap increases progress by 5; 20 taps publishes the stream.
- Publishing hides the tap zone, adds randomized cozy viewers, updates the HUD, shows feedback, then returns to choice selection after a short delay.
- Audio unlock remains user-gesture safe and optional.

## Remixed target
Streamer Tycoon. A satirical game inspired by The Office built around streamer tycoon play, with creative, cozy, customizable energy, anti anxiety session design, search-friendly hooks like streamer tycoon, tycoon, idle, aesthetics like rainbowcore, y2k, decora kei, and meme-tone cues such as labubu, bestie. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The remixed game reframes the loop as a cozy, satirical office creator pod: the player is a desk-streaming bestie clocking in, picking workplace meme arcs, tapping hype memos, and turning low-pressure content into viewer growth.
